Strategy: Reward one narrow usable band and penalize one narrow dead band. Leftovers just above one item pair best, while middle dead leftovers waste most; elsewhere plain tightness decides. Score by leftover: bonus for the usable band, penalty for the dead band, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin in the rewarded band. Exact fits rank top. It may help by targeting the best pairing size, but may fail if the bands rarely match.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if item <= r - item < item * 3 / 2 else 0) - (item if item / 4 <= r - item < item * 3 / 4 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Narrow bands: bonus for leftover in [item, 1.5*item), penalty for leftover in [item/4, 3*item/4).
